meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 agent-browser 命令操作浏览器:打开网页、按快照编号点击或填表、截图与导出 PDF、提取页面数据,也能录制视频、比对页面差异、查看网络请求。
howto.when: 当你要做网页测试、填写表单或截图/提取网页信息时触发;需要访问网站或与页面交互时也会接手。

say.text: 打开 example.com/form,填好邮箱和密码然后点提交
say.note: Claude 打开页面、按元素编号填表并点击提交

say.text: 截一张全页图并标出可点击元素的编号
say.note: 生成带编号标注的整页截图

say.text: 把这个列表页的商品名称和价格抓下来
say.note: 读取元素文本并汇总输出

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude controls a browser via the agent-browser CLI: opening pages, clicking or filling elements by snapshot refs, taking screenshots/PDFs, and extracting page data; also video recording, page diffs and network inspection.
howto.when_en: Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com/form, fill in the email and password, then click Submit
say_en.note: Claude opens the page, fills fields by ref, then clicks

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot with numbered labels on clickable elements
Scrape the product names and prices from this listing page
say_en.note: Reads element text and reports the values
